name: Threadbrief

cover.alt: Threadbrief: a mint thread leads to a stack of notes labeled Goal, Done and Next.

description: Pick up where your agent left off. Read its last reply or a saved handoff with the goal, result and next step.

settings.title: Show the plugin icon
settings.description: Show the plugin mark on the settings gear. The sidebar tab is unchanged.

settings.title: Use the agent’s last reply
settings.description: Show a completed session’s reply when no saved report is available.

settings.title: Read paired session history
settings.description: Allow Threadbrief to read the selected session from its paired Orca server. Recap requests stay on that server.

settings.title: Recap strategy
settings.description: Instant uses saved text. Brief and Detailed let you preview a prompt and start a separate Orca agent only when you choose.

settings.title: Preferred recap agent
settings.description: The installed Orca agent selected in Threadbrief. Empty uses Orca’s default.

settings.title: Open for new worktrees
settings.description: Open the panel only when the new worktree has a saved summary.

settings.title: Pause updates while reading
settings.description: Keep the displayed brief while you read it. Turn off to show each new result immediately, even when the panel has focus.

settings.title: Show profile commands
settings.description: Show optional workflow actions for projects that match an enabled profile. This does not affect summaries.

settings.title: Profile commands: show first
settings.description: Choose the first button shown for a profile command. Both buttons remain available. Neither runs the command.
